html:
SMTO-CFG-0098 — A question about this Skill is already waiting for you

GUID: c8c473e9-dae9-55bd-a1a2-c876ab98de5f
Slug: capability-activation-grant-pending
Domain: CFG · Subsystem: capability_activation

What happened

  • SMTO already asked whether to allow this Skill for the current request. It won't ask a second time, and the task waits for your answer to the first question.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Scroll to the task and find the question asking whether to enable the Skill. Select Allow for this conversation (or Allow for this task) or Don't allow. That existing question is the only one SMTO will take an answer for in this request.
  2. If you can't see the question, reload the page in your browser. Reloading redraws the task together with the question SMTO is waiting on.
  3. Answer from one window or device only. Once one window answers, the same question in another window becomes out of date.

What success looks like

  • The question disappears and the task continues.

If it still fails

  • If no question appears after reloading, select Copy error details in this panel and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't send the request again as a new message just to get a new question; that starts a separate request.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Capability activation found an existing grant record for the same run, task source digest and requested Skill set, so it reused that grant_request_id and logged grant_pending instead of creating a new question.

What this means

  • The same run/source/requested-Skill set already has a durable grant record, so activation reuses its identity and records grant_pending. The owning policy, configuration or publication transaction validates this state. Diagnostics do not grant authority, replace accepted snapshots, execute capabilities or publish a site; preserve the exact current decision and evidence.

Why this can happen

  • The same run/source/requested-Skill set already has a durable grant record, so activation reuses its identity and records grant_pending.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the existing grant_request_id and current interaction state; creating another question would not resolve it.

How to fix it

  • Resolve the existing grant: find its grant_request_id in state.capability_grants (state required or prompted) and submit an allow or deny decision against the current pending_wait operation_id. Another question cannot be created for the same run, task source and Skill set, and would not resolve it.
  • A capability question already exists for this request. Reuse its runtime-issued question ID.

Retry and execution caution

  • The reported capability or interaction condition changes.

How to verify the fix

  • The existing matching interaction is answered or settled once.

What not to do

  • Do not bypass frozen authority, operation permissions or credential requirements.

Technical notes

  • The owning policy, configuration or publication transaction validates this state. Diagnostics do not grant authority, replace accepted snapshots, execute capabilities or publish a site; preserve the exact current decision and evidence.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
